deploy_summary_not_deployed_title: This app has no deploy yet
deploy_summary_not_deployed_body: Once you deploy it, its replicas, CPU, memory and tasks show up here.
deploy_live_paused: Paused while the tab is hidden
deploy_dialog_body: Creates a deploy with the current configuration, pending changes included.
deploy_dialog_image_hint: Empty: repeats the current deploy's image. A tag is resolved again; a pinned digest is kept.
deploy_dialog_invalid_image: Not a valid image reference: registry/repository[:tag], with a lowercase repository and no spaces.
deploy_toast_queued_body: You can follow it in Deploys.
deploy_rollback_body: Goes back to the images of the previous successful deploy. Later deploys without an image repeat that version.
deploy_rollback_unknown_target: muelle picks the successful deploy before the current one.
deploy_rollback_none_title: There's nothing to go back to.
deploy_rollback_none_body: There's no successful deploy before the current one.
deploy_deploys_subtitle: One deploy at a time per app; if another arrives, the queued one is replaced.
deploy_deploys_empty_body: The first one shows up here as soon as you queue it.
deploy_log_polling: No live connection: the log refreshes every second.
deploy_proxy_warning_title: Caddy didn't take this deploy's routes.
deploy_proxy_warning_body: {error}. muelle retries on its own; until then the app's domains may not respond.
deploy_proxy_warning_generic: muelle retries on its own; until then the app's domains may not respond.
deploy_proxy_warning_synced: Caddy didn't take this deploy's routes, but the proxy has synced since.
deploy_logs_subtitle: Live from Docker. muelle stores nothing.
deploy_logs_no_services_title: This app has no services in Swarm
deploy_logs_no_services_body: Deploy it to see its logs.
deploy_linked_missing: Deploy #{id} no longer exists: showing the latest one.

match.totalPlural=one: {sampled} of 1 replica measured (only those on muelle’s node)
match.totalPlural=*: {sampled} of {total} replicas measured (only those on muelle’s node)

deploy_logs_unreachable_title: Could not connect to the logs.
deploy_logs_retrying_body: It retries on its own in a few seconds; earlier lines stay.
deploy_logs_ended_body: There are no more logs to follow. If you deploy it again, reconnect.
deploy_error_docker: Docker is not responding on the muelle server (or the node is not a Swarm manager).
deploy_dialog_reason_both: Send one image for the app or one per service, not both.
deploy_dialog_reason_compose: This is a compose app: images go per service.
deploy_dialog_reason_unknown_service: The service {service} no longer exists in the app configuration.
deploy_error_app_removing: The app is being deleted: it doesn't accept deploys meanwhile (2 minutes at most).
deploy_dialog_rollback_pin_title: The image is still pinned by rollback #{id}.
deploy_dialog_digest_pin_title: The image is pinned to a digest.
deploy_dialog_pinned_body: Without a new image, that digest is deployed once more. To use another image or a tag (like :staging), type it here or change it in the configuration.
